//: Template for Raspberry Pi Imager's OS list. tools/make_rpi_image.sh fills in the extract_/image_download_ size and sha256 fields, url and icon (from --repo, the download repository - rpi-imager/images/<version>/ is where tools/repo_publish.sh image puts the file) for whichever architecture it just built, from a copy of this file; tools/repo_index.py on the server writes the published rpi-imager/os_list.json from it, which Imager takes as a repository URL (App Options -> Content Repository). 'devices' is left out on purpose - Imager treats a missing 'devices' as 'offer this OS everywhere'. Every field starting with __ is a placeholder token
